Test Scenario: Verify clicking "Let's Start" on the discovery result screen redirects the student to the F1 (Foundation Level 1) module landing
Precondition: Discovery flow completed and the placement/result screen (/discover-end) is displayed (e.g. after failing the Letter Hunt in TC-012)
Steps:
1. Complete the Discovery flow and reach the final placement/result screen (/discover-end)
2. Locate the 'Let's Start' button on the result screen (label is rendered as an SVG, so it is clicked via the centred result-screen button)
3. Click the 'Let's Start' button
4. Wait for navigation away from /discover-end
5. Verify the F1 learning-journey map loads and the 'Start F1' entry button is visible
Expected Result: On clicking 'Let's Start', the application should navigate away from /discover-end to the F1 module landing (learning-journey map at /discover-start). The F1 landing should load correctly, showing the 'Start F1' entry button (with Beginner / Level 1 markers).
